text:
- TOTAL revenue reached £88.5k in TW versus £60.8k in LW, a WoW increase of 45.6%.
- TOTAL units hit 51,065 in TW, up 105.8% WoW, while TOTAL orders reached 2,019, up 4.7% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER led TW with £6,009.01 in revenue, a 6.8% share of TOTAL.
- ROTATING SILVER ANGELS T-LIGHT HLDR posted £5,866.33 in TW (6.6% share) and added £5,115.86 WoW, the largest absolute gain.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS delivered £4,046.96 in TW (4.6% share) with a WoW gain of £2,661.37.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER took £2,754.49 and CHILLI LIGHTS £2,473.89 in TW, with the top 5 products at 23.9% of TOTAL revenue.
- PARTY BUNTING fell £2,522.92 WoW (-70.1%) and JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT fell £1,396.83 WoW, while HEART OF WICKER LARGE declined 44.2% WoW.
- SET OF 3 BABUSHKA STACKING TINS rose 2,482.8% WoW and BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME rose 1,445.8% WoW; BROCADE RING PURSE was the TW unit leader at 5,632 units.
